## Topaz Video Interpolate API

Topaz Video Interpolate is a video editing model by Topaz Labs, available on the Venice API as `topaz-video-interpolate`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

Topaz Video Interpolate generates in-between frames to retime an existing video to 30, 60 or 120 fps at the source resolution, with optional 2x, 4x or 8x slow motion.

### How to use the Topaz Video Interpolate API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "topaz-video-interpolate"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "topaz-video-interpolate",
    "prompt": "Turn the scene into a snowy winter morning",
    "video_url": "https://example.com/source.mp4"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready (JSON with the status until then)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "topaz-video-interpolate", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4

# If the queue response has a download_url, retrieve only reports the
# status: download the MP4 from that URL once it is COMPLETED.
```
